item.title: Cherry & Superior Boys Basketball Remains Perfect on the Season
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The Duluth Marshall boys basketball team hosted the undefeated Cherry Tigers on Monday night. The Tigers improve to 3-0 on the season, taking down the Hilltoppers 75-57. Over in Wisconsin, the Superior Spartans took on the Proctor Rails.
